Sam Altman has backed Induced AI, a startup founded this year by two teenagers that automates business workflows by converting plain English instructions to pseudo-code in real time.

Google held its annual hardware event to showcase updates on the Pixel 8, Pixel 8 Pro, Pixel Fold, Android 14, Pixel Buds, Google Assistant, Bard, and Pixel Watch 2. A review of the Pixel 8 Pro highlights improved cameras, a brighter screen, and enhanced AI-powered features as upgrades over the Pixel 7 Pro, though it notes an underutilized temperature sensor.

Flexport, a freight forwarding and customs brokerage startup, is valued at $8 billion. Dave Clark, the former Amazon executive ousted as Flexport CEO just a year into the job, criticized the company's founder and board in a Monday post on X following CNBC reporting.

In the SBF trial, the prosecution argued Bankman-Fried knowingly committed fraud for wealth and power, while the defense claimed he acted in good faith and got over his head. Michael Lewis's book 'Going Infinite' details Sam Bankman-Fried's attempt to buy off Donald Trump to prevent him from running for president again, details emerging during the Manhattan Federal Court trial. Jacquelyn and Alex discussed the SBF trial, noting Jacquelyn's presence at the Southern District of New York courthouse listening to Bankman-Fried's case.

LinkedIn launched AI tools for job hunting, marketing, and sales, including an updated Recruiter platform, an AI Learning coach, and a marketing campaign tool.

IronNet, founded in 2014 by former NSA director Keith Alexander, collapsed after going public in August 2021, laying off staff and seeing its stock price decline despite raising over $400 million.

Esther Rodriguez-Villegas, a career academic turned founder of Acurable, explains how her company creates wearable devices to diagnose and manage respiratory conditions like sleep apnea and epilepsy.

Elon Musk claimed X generated 100–200 million posts daily in September, while CEO Linda Yaccarino later stated the figure was 500 million posts per day.
